function.name: scope_check
function.description: Check whether a target is inside the authorized engagement scope before any active action. Use this first when the target is unfamiliar or the request is ambiguous.

target.description: IPv4 address, CIDR, or hostname to check.

function.name: nmap_scan
function.description: Run a read-only nmap scan against a target explicitly inside the authorized scope. Use for host discovery and service/version detection. Never use against public IPs, public domains, or anything outside the scope file. Returns stdout, stderr and exit code.

target.description: IPv4, hostname, or CIDR inside scope.

function.name: http_probe
function.description: Fetch HTTP response headers and basic metadata from an in-scope URL. Use for technology and status identification. Do not use for authentication attempts or fuzzing.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL whose host is inside scope.

function.name: dns_lookup
function.description: Resolve DNS records for an in-scope name. Read-only.

function.name: tls_info
function.description: Inspect the TLS certificate and negotiated protocol for an in-scope host. Read-only.

function.name: kali_exec
function.description: Run an allowlisted Kali CLI command in the isolated lab container. Use only for read-only enumeration tools approved by the engagement. The policy layer rejects destructive commands and targets outside scope. Never use for shell pipelines that download and execute code.

command.description: A single command using an allowlisted binary (nmap, curl, dig, openssl, nikto, whatweb, gobuster, ffuf, smbclient, enum4linux).

function.name: report_finding
function.description: Record a finding with evidence and remediation. Use after verifying an observation. Does not execute anything.

evidence.description: Command(s) and observed output supporting the finding.
